digestNormalization.rationale: Frozen per contract; digest excludes self-referential and decision-bound fields.
digestNormalization.stalenessRule: REJECT-STALE when the digest differs from the latest non-superseded adoption decision for this contract path.

adoptionSource: Operator Travis James, explicit form answers kbd-plan-decisions on 2026-11-09 (decision-log.md) plus goals.md of 2026-11-09 and the 2026-11-09 naming/500-line instruction.
amendmentPolicy: Material scope or acceptance changes require explicit operator adoption recorded as a new canonical decision with supersedes; suggestions never auto-enter task totals.

releaseClaim.userOperation: A developer starts the Know Meet shell on web (browser), desktop (Tauri running the same web build) and mobile (Flutter) and sees the app frame plus the static screens of home, sign-in, join, dashboard, agents, recordings and settings, and the meeting-room layout with media stubbed, in dark and light themes, visually matching the design prototype; all generator output (Rust core, flutter_rust_bridge, Axum BFF, UAR, PEM) is kept and builds.
supportedEnvironments: Mobile: iOS simulator and Android emulator
releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: Design references only (docs/design prototypes, tokens.json/tokens.css); no application workspace, no shell code, no build/test/lint commands.
explicitUnknowns: Whether Windows/Linux desktop is required this phase (assumed no)
Cause of the 4 failing Prometheus doctor health checks
Exact visual tolerance for screenshot comparison (proposed: per-route pixel-diff threshold set in spec)
Whether kept UAR/PEM/Axum payloads compile unchanged under the pinned toolchain

scenarioMatrix.name: Web shell matches the prototype on every in-scope route in both themes
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: pnpm --filter @know-meet/web build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/fidelity --project=web
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Per-route screenshots at 375/768/1024/1440 in dark and light are within the spec tolerance of the prototype baselines captured in c03.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Same comparison against a build with tokens reverted to pre-reconciliation tokens.json must FAIL.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Baselines captured from docs/design/prototype at a recorded git digest into tests/fidelity/baselines; scratch output dir per run.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Playwright report, diff images, argv, exit code, baseline digest.

scenarioMatrix.name: Desktop runs the identical web bundle in a branded native window
scenarioMatrix.oracle: The frontendDist content digest equals the apps/web/dist digest; the app launches to the home route with the custom titlebar.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: A desktop build pointed at a separately built copy with one changed byte must report a digest mismatch.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: apps/web/dist built once per run; digests recorded.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Digest pair, tauri build log, launch screenshot.

scenarioMatrix.name: Flutter shell matches tokens and in-scope screens in both themes
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Golden images for the in-scope phone layouts in dark and light match reviewed goldens; ThemeData values equal generated tokens.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Running with stock ThemeData.dark() must FAIL the goldens.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Goldens committed under apps/mobile/test/goldens with digests.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: flutter test output, failing-diff images if any.

scenarioMatrix.name: One token edit propagates to web, desktop and Flutter outputs
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Changing one colour in a scratch copy of tokens.json changes the corresponding CSS variable, Tailwind theme value and Dart constant; nothing else changes.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: An invalid colour or missing output dir makes the generator exit non-zero (no silent skip).
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Scratch copy of docs/design/tokens.json; outputs written to a scratch dir.

scenarioMatrix.name: Plain web build works without the Tauri runtime
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Home route renders with zero console errors and no Tauri API calls outside isTauri() guards.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: An unguarded Tauri import injected in a scratch branch must produce a blank page/console error that the smoke detects.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Production build; scratch branch for negative control.

scenarioMatrix.name: Repository rules hold: kebab-case names, 500-line limit, lint and typecheck
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scenarioMatrix.oracle: All checks exit 0 with the adopted exception globs (E-N1..E-N6, E-L1..E-L8; design prototypes exempt; CHANGELOG exempt).
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: A scratch 501-line .ts file and a PascalCase .tsx file each make the check exit non-zero.

scenarioMatrix.name: Kept generator surfaces build: Rust core, flutter_rust_bridge, Axum BFF
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Workspace checks and the BFF builds with zero errors; FRB bindings regenerate without diff.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Removing a crate from the workspace makes cargo check fail.

functionalScope: pnpm workspace, toolchain pins, lint/typecheck/test commands, naming and line-limit enforcement
Reconciled token source in docs/design/tokens.json and self-hosted fonts
Vendored, extended token generator emitting web CSS, shadcn variables, Tailwind theme, Dart tokens and ThemeData
Generator output imported in full (Tauri, Flutter, Rust core, FRB, Axum BFF, UAR, PEM)
Single React 19 web bundle shared by web and Tauri, four-layer clean architecture
Shared shadcn/ui kit themed by tokens
App frame, navigation and theme switching on web/desktop and Flutter
Static in-scope screens on web/desktop and Flutter, meeting-room layout with media stubbed

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow; exhaustion means checkpoint + BLOCKED. Only never-adopted optional items may defer.

exclusions: LiveKit media, recording, transcription and the token service
Real data and persistence beyond what the generator ships
Screens and states outside the adopted in-scope list
requiredSafetyChecks: No secrets in tracked files (git grep --untracked secret patterns clean)
LiveKit API secret never reaches web, Tauri webview or Flutter code
Tauri capabilities least-privilege; CSP restricts font-src/script-src to self
Every Tauri API call guarded by isTauri() in shared web code
WCAG 2.2 AA contrast for text in both themes

budgets.tokenFallback: Checkpoint after each change; stop and report if a change exceeds 2x its size estimate.
budgets.exhaustion: checkpoint + BLOCKED; never silent PASS; docs/state may be saved without running product tests.

evidenceInvalidation: Keyed by contract digest, git commit of the tested tree, tokens.json digest and prototype baseline digest; only evidence whose key changed is invalidated; history preserved.
